title: Pagination Boundaries Disabled
description: Nobody should be able to click "Previous" into negative-page territory, or "Next" past the last page into an empty void. The pagination buttons need to know their own edges.
successCondition: On /tracking's pagination nav, the "Previous" button is disabled while on page 1, and the "Next" button is disabled while on the final page (page >= totalPages) — both re-enabling correctly once navigated away from that boundary.
hints: With few enough shipments there may only be one page total — in that case both buttons should be disabled simultaneously, which is itself worth checking as an edge case.
totalPages is computed as Math.ceil(total / pageSize) with a floor of 1 — verify against that formula if the boundary seems off by one.
